title: Getting Around Waikiki — Tourist Transportation Guide App

requirements.text: Create a backend that stores transportation guide data for Waikiki/Oahu, including sections for: TheBus, Biki bike share, trolleys, rideshares (Uber/Lyft), car rentals, walking, and other local transport options. Each entry should have a title, description, pricing info, and practical tips.

quotes: TheBus and Biki bikes to trolleys, rideshares, car rentals

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores at least 7 transportation categories
Each category includes title, description, pricing, and tips fields
Data is queryable from the frontend

requirements.text: Build a frontend transportation guide that displays all Waikiki/Oahu transportation options. Each section should show the transport type, pricing information, and practical tips for tourists. Include a clear navigation or filtering mechanism to browse categories.

quotes: Each section includes tips, pricing info, and practical advice for navigating the island

acceptanceCriteria: All transportation categories are displayed on the page
Each card/section shows title, pricing, description, and tips
Users can browse or filter by category
Content is readable and well-organized on both mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Apply a warm, tropical visual theme inspired by Hawaii — using sandy, ocean, and sunset tones (e.g., warm coral, sandy beige, ocean teal). Use a clean, airy layout with bold section headers and friendly typography that feels welcoming to tourists. Apply the theme consistently across all UI components.
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette reflects a tropical Hawaiian aesthetic without using blue/purple as primary colors
Theme is consistent across all sections and components

requirements.text: Generate and display a hero banner image at the top of the guide featuring a scenic Waikiki beach and cityscape with a tropical, sun-drenched atmosphere to set the visual tone of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero image is displayed prominently at the top of the page
Image complements the tropical visual theme

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Real-time transit tracking or live bus/trolley arrival times
Booking or purchasing tickets through the app

required: Scenic Waikiki beachfront panorama with palm trees, ocean water, and the Diamond Head crater in golden sunlight (waikiki-hero.dim_1200x400.png)
Flat icon set of 7 transportation modes: bus, bicycle, trolley, car, rideshare, walking figure, scooter — in a warm coral and teal color palette (transport-icons.dim_512x128.png)
